blocks.arabic_head: الحمد لله. الحمد لله الذي اختار
blocks.text: All praise is due to Allah. All praise is due to Allah, who chose for His Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, the best of companions.

blocks.arabic_head: فامنوا به وصدقوه واتبعوه ووقروه وبذلوا
blocks.text: They believed in him, affirmed his truthfulness, followed him, honored him, and gave their lives and wealth in the path of his religion, carrying the message of Islam to all generations.

blocks.arabic_head: نحمده سبحانه ونشكره على نعمه العظام.
blocks.text: We praise Him, the Glorified, and thank Him for His immense blessings. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger, may Allah send His peace and blessings upon him, upon his family, his companions, and all those who follow them in goodness until the Day of Judgment.

blocks.arabic_head: أما بعد. فاوصيكم ونفسي بتقوى الله
blocks.text: To proceed: I counsel you and myself to have taqwa of Allah, for it is the counsel of Allah to those of old and those who come after.

blocks.arabic_head: ولقد وصينا الذين اوتوا الكتاب من
blocks.text: Allah says: And We have instructed those who were given the Scripture before you and yourselves to fear Allah.

blocks.arabic_head: عباد الله، إن الحديث عن صحابة
blocks.text: O servants of Allah, speaking about the companions of Rasulullah, peace and blessings be upon him, is not speaking about pages of history that have turned and closed, nor names that are mentioned and then forgotten.

blocks.arabic_head: بل هو حديث عن جيل اختاره
blocks.text: Rather, it is speaking about a generation that Allah chose to accompany the best of His creation, His Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, to carry His religion and convey His message.

blocks.arabic_head: فصحبوا رسول الله صلى الله عليه
blocks.text: They accompanied Rasulullah, peace and blessings be upon him, heard from him directly, supported him, sheltered him, strengthened him, and gave their wealth and their lives in the service of this religion and in following his Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him.

blocks.arabic_head: ولم ولم يكف الله جل وعلا
blocks.text: And Allah did not leave the declaration of their virtue to the words and opinions of people. Rather, Allah praised them in His Book and bore witness to His pleasure with them, as He said:

blocks.arabic_head: والسابقون الاولون من المهاجرين والانصار والذين
blocks.text: Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him.

blocks.arabic_head: وشهد لهم نبينا صلى الله عليه
blocks.text: And our Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, testified to their excellence, saying: 'The best of my Ummah is my generation, then those who follow them, then those who follow them.'

blocks.arabic_head: متفق عليه. فاذا اثنى الله جل
blocks.text: Agreed upon. So when Allah has praised them and His Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, has testified to their excellence, what praise could come after the praise of Allah, and what testimony could come after the testimony of His Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him?

blocks.arabic_head: فيا ايها المسلمون ومن اعظم افضال
blocks.text: O Muslims, among the greatest favors the companions have done for us is their transmission of the Sunnah of our Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, to us.

blocks.arabic_head: فبروايتهم عرفنا صلاته وزكاته وحجه وصيامه
blocks.text: Through their narrations we came to know his Salah, his Zakat, his Hajj, his fasting, his worship, and his guidance. They carried the religion to those who came after them, fulfilled the trust, and conveyed the message. They were faithful to what they heard and truthful in what they transmitted. May Allah be pleased with them and make them pleased.

blocks.arabic_head: ومن حق هؤلاء الكرام علينا يا
blocks.text: And among what these noble ones are owed by us, O servants of Allah, is that we love them, invoke Allah's pleasure upon them, acknowledge their virtue and standing, and guard our tongues regarding them.

blocks.arabic_head: فقد علمنا الله دعاء المؤمنين لمن
blocks.text: For Allah has taught us the supplication of the believers for those who preceded them in faith, saying:

blocks.arabic_head: والذين جاءوا من بعدهم يقولون ربنا
blocks.text: And there is a share for those who came after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

blocks.arabic_head: فما اجملها من اية عظيمة تربي
blocks.text: Compassionate, Merciful. What a magnificent Ayah it is, nurturing both the heart and the tongue: a prayer for their forgiveness, an acknowledgment of their brotherhood, and a request to Allah to purify the heart of any rancor toward them.

blocks.arabic_head: وقد جعل النبي صلى الله عليه
blocks.text: And the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, made love of the Ansar a sign of faith.

blocks.arabic_head: وبغضهم علامة على النفاق فقال صلى
blocks.text: And hatred of them a sign of hypocrisy, as he, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “Love for the Ansar is a sign of faith and hatred for the Ansar is a sign of hypocrisy.”

blocks.arabic_head: متفق عليه. فيا ايها الاحبة ولذلك
blocks.text: Agreed upon. So, dear beloved ones, it is for this reason that the methodology of Ahlus Sunnah wal Jama'ah, by the grace of Allah, is characterized by the soundness of their hearts and tongues toward the companions of Rasulullah, peace and blessings be upon him.

blocks.arabic_head: فلا يتخذون عرضا فلا يتخذون غرضا
blocks.text: They do not make the companions a target for abuse, nor an arena for slander, and they do not spread doubts and lies about them.

blocks.arabic_head: وقد قال الحبيب صلى الله عليه
blocks.text: And the beloved Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'Do not revile my companions, for if one of you were to spend gold equal to the mountain of Uhud, it would not reach a mudd of one of theirs, nor even half of it.'

blocks.arabic_head: متفق عليه. فيا لها من كلمات
blocks.text: Agreed upon. What profound words that teach generations their true worth. For the companions combined the honor of companionship with tremendous sacrifice and selflessness, despite the scarcity of provisions and equipment that many of them had, and despite the harm and persecution they endured. Yet through all of that, faith and steadfastness became deeply rooted in their hearts, and resolve and striving grew great within their souls.

blocks.arabic_head: والجهاد فمضوا على الحق ونصروا الدين
blocks.text: And they pressed on upon the truth, gave victory to the religion, carried the message, and surpassed those who came after them in a way that cannot be matched. May Allah be pleased with them and make them pleased.

blocks.arabic_head: ومن هنا اشتد كلام ائمة السنة
blocks.text: It is for this reason that the scholars of the Sunnah spoke harshly about anyone who dares to speak ill of them. Abu Nu'aym, may Allah have mercy on him, said: 'No one stretches his tongue against them except one whose ill intent is directed at the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, his companions, Islam, and the Muslims.'

blocks.arabic_head: فليكن حديثنا عنهم يا عباد الله
blocks.text: So let our speech about them, O servants of Allah, always be accompanied by love and reverence, and let our mention of them be connected to invoking Allah's pleasure upon them and to honoring their standing.

blocks.arabic_head: وليعلم ابنائنا سيرهم وماثرهم وفضلهم فهم
blocks.text: Let our children learn their biographies, their noble deeds, and their virtues, for they are those who accompanied the best of creation and carried this religion to all of humanity.

blocks.arabic_head: فاللهم ارض عن اصحاب نبيك اجمعين
blocks.text: O Allah, be pleased with all the companions of Your Prophet and reward them with the best of rewards on behalf of Islam and the Muslims. Gather us in the company of our Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and his companions, not among the disgraced or the misguided.

blocks.arabic_head: اقول ما تسمعون واستغفر الله لي
blocks.text: I say what you hear and I seek forgiveness from Allah for myself and for you, for our parents, our spouses, our children, and for all Muslims. So seek His forgiveness, for He is the Most Righteous, the Most Merciful.

blocks.arabic_head: الحمد لله الذي جعل النجوم امنة
blocks.text: All praise is due to Allah, who made the stars a protection for the sky, who made His Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, a light dispelling all darkness, and who chose his companions, making them a selected few from among the righteous and a firm barrier against innovations and desires.

blocks.arabic_head: واشهد ان لا اله الا الله
blocks.text: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger, the seal of the Prophets, may Allah send His peace and blessings upon him, upon his noble and loyal family, and upon his radiant and honorable companions, with abundant salutations until the Day of Judgment and the Final Decree.

blocks.arabic_head: اما بعد فاتقوا الله عباد الله
blocks.text: To proceed: Fear Allah, O servants of Allah, and know, may Allah have mercy on me and you, that the most complete of people in reason, the broadest in knowledge, and the finest in deeds are the companions of Rasulullah, peace and blessings be upon him.

blocks.arabic_head: وهم كما قال الامام الشافعي رحمه
blocks.text: And they are, as Imam al-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: 'They are above us in every field of knowledge, jurisprudence, piety, and reason, and their opinions are a light and a guiding illumination for us.'

blocks.arabic_head: اولئك جيل عظيم وقرن فريد ما
blocks.text: They were a great generation and a unique era. There has never been and never will be anyone like them.

blocks.arabic_head: فذكر فضائلهم عبادة والاقتداء بهم هداية
blocks.text: Mentioning their virtues is an act of worship, following their example is guidance and safety, and loving them is a means of drawing closer to Allah and an act of devotion.

blocks.arabic_head: انفقوا اموالهم وبذلوا ارواحهم في نصرة
blocks.text: They spent their wealth and gave their lives in support of the religion of Allah and for the sake of His Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him.

blocks.arabic_head: واهل السنة والجماعة يا عباد الله
blocks.text: And Ahlus Sunnah wal Jama'ah, O servants of Allah, as you know, refrain from engaging in the disputes that arose among the companions of Rasulullah, peace and blessings be upon him.

blocks.arabic_head: سئل عمر بن عبد العزيز عن
blocks.text: Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz was asked about the fighting that took place among the companions, may Allah be pleased with them, and he said: 'Those are bloods that Allah has kept my hands free from, and I would not wish to stain my tongue in them either.'

blocks.arabic_head: فيا ايها المسلمون لقد كان سلف
blocks.text: O Muslims, the righteous predecessors of this Ummah used to plant in the hearts of their children love for the companions, may Allah be pleased with them.

blocks.arabic_head: وكان السلف يعلمون اولادهم حب ابي
blocks.text: The early generations would teach their children love of Abu Bakr and Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, just as they would teach them a Surah of the Quran.

blocks.arabic_head: وان سب الصحابة امر خطير وجرم
blocks.text: And reviling the companions is a serious matter and a grave offense that undermines one's creed and indicates ill intent.

blocks.arabic_head: سئل الامام احمد رحمه الله عمن
blocks.text: Imam Ahmad, may Allah have mercy on him, was asked about someone who insults Abu Bakr, Umar, and Aisha, may Allah be pleased with them, and he said: 'I do not consider him to be upon Islam.'

blocks.arabic_head: فاللهم ارض عن الصحابة الاخيار وال
blocks.text: O Allah, be pleased with the righteous companions and with the pure household of Your Prophet, O Lord of Majesty and Honor.

blocks.arabic_head: فيا عباد الله نحمد الله على
blocks.text: O servants of Allah, we praise Allah for the blessing He has bestowed upon us of soundness in creed and of following the way of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, without any innovation.

blocks.arabic_head: ووسطية بلا غلو وتفريط وانحلال. فاللهم
blocks.text: A moderate way free of extremism, negligence, and moral laxity. O Allah, O Lord of Majesty and Honor, grant us moderation and balance, and the methodology upon which the companions of Your Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, walked, following him without being extreme or fanatical, O Lord of Majesty and Honor.

blocks.arabic_head: عباد الله كما تعلمون وشاهدتم الاعتداء
blocks.text: O servants of Allah, as you know and have witnessed, the ongoing aggression of the Houthi group, who are transgressors and astray in their creed.

blocks.arabic_head: فعليكم يا عباد الله واخر ما
blocks.text: Be aware, O servants of Allah, that the most recent of their acts was the aggression against the city of Rasulullah, peace and blessings be upon him.

blocks.arabic_head: وان هذا والله لهو ضلال كبير
blocks.text: And this, by Allah, is truly a great and immense misguidance. We ask Allah, the All-Powerful, the All-Mighty, to take retribution for Islam and the Muslims against them, to suffice us against their evil, and to turn their plotting into destruction upon themselves and upon those who stand behind them among the Rafidah transgressors who harbor hatred against Ahlus Sunnah wal Jama'ah.

blocks.arabic_head: فاللهم يا ذا الجلال والاكرام انا
blocks.text: O Allah, O Lord of Majesty and Honor, we seek Your protection against the throats of our enemies and the enemies of Your religion and the enemies of the Sunnah of Your Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and the enemies of this blessed land, the Land of the Two Holy Mosques, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

blocks.arabic_head: فاللهم احفظها بحفظك، اللهم احفظ سماءها
blocks.text: O Allah, protect it with Your protection. O Allah, protect its sky, its airspace, its land, and its sea, O Best of Protectors.

blocks.arabic_head: اللهم واكشف لنا سوء الخادعين والمنافقين
blocks.text: O Allah, expose for us the evil schemes of the deceivers and the hypocrites, O All-Knowing, O All-Aware.

blocks.arabic_head: عباد الله الا وصلوا وسلموا على
blocks.text: O servants of Allah, send prayers and salutations upon the one whom we have been commanded to honor with prayers and salutations.

blocks.arabic_head: اللهم صل على محمد وعلى ال
blocks.text: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent Your blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are the Most Praiseworthy, the Most Glorious.

blocks.arabic_head: وبارك اللهم على محمد وعلى ال
blocks.text: And bestow Your blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You bestowed Your blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are the Most Praiseworthy, the Most Glorious.

blocks.arabic_head: وارض اللهم عن الخلفاء الراشدين الائمة
blocks.text: O Allah, be pleased with the Rightly-Guided Caliphs, the rightly-guided Imams: Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, and Ali, and with all of the companions of Your Prophet, his wives the mothers of the believers, and those who followed them in goodness. And include us among them through Your favor, generosity, and grace, O Lord of Majesty and Honor.

blocks.arabic_head: اللهم يا حافظ يا حفيظ احفظ
blocks.text: O Allah, O Protector, O Guardian, protect Islam, the Muslims, and the lands of the Muslims.

blocks.arabic_head: اللهم احفظ الاسلام والمسلمين وبلاد المسلمين
blocks.text: O Allah, protect Islam, the Muslims, and the lands of the Muslims from all harm and evil.

blocks.arabic_head: اللهم احفظ بلاد الحرمين الشريفين. واحفظ
blocks.text: O Allah, protect the Land of the Two Holy Mosques. O Allah, protect our brothers in Syria and in Palestine. O Allah, be with our brothers in Gaza, in Sudan, and in Yemen, O Best of Protectors.

blocks.arabic_head: اللهم ان اعدائك واعداء دينك واعداء
blocks.text: O Allah, Your enemies and the enemies of Your religion and the enemies of the Sunnah of Your Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, are lying in wait against us and against our Muslim brothers. So, O Allah, turn their plotting against their own throats and make it a destruction for them, O All-Powerful, O All-Wise, O All-Mighty.

blocks.arabic_head: اللهم واحفظ ولي امرنا خادم الحرمين
blocks.text: O Allah, protect our guardian, the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, King Salman ibn Abd al-Aziz, and his Crown Prince, Prince Muhammad ibn Salman. O Allah, extend their lives in Your obedience with health and well-being, support them and do not support anyone against them, grant them success, strengthen their resolve, and provide them with righteous and sincere advisors.

blocks.arabic_head: واحفظ اللهم وقوي عزائم رجال امننا
blocks.text: O Allah, protect and strengthen the resolve of the men of our security forces, the men of defense, the men of the armed forces, and all security sectors. O Allah, grant them insight into our enemy and the enemy of our land, O Lord of Majesty and Honor.

blocks.arabic_head: اللهم اغفر للمسلمين والمسلمات والمؤمنين والمؤمنات
blocks.text: O Allah, forgive the Muslim men and women and the believing men and women, and especially our fathers and mothers. O Allah, reform the husbands and wives and the sons and daughters.

blocks.arabic_head: اللهم انزل على بيوتنا وبيوت المسلمين
blocks.text: O Allah, send down upon our homes and the homes of Muslims tranquility, happiness, harmony, love, and mercy, O Lord of Majesty and Honor.

blocks.arabic_head: وابعد عنا وعن بيوت المسلمين الشقاق
blocks.text: And keep away from us and from the homes of the Muslims discord, conflict, divorce, hatred, envy, the evil eye, sorcery, and illness, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy.

blocks.arabic_head: ربنا اتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي
blocks.text: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

blocks.arabic_head: سبحان ربك رب العزة عما يصفون
blocks.text: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe. And peace upon the messengers. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
